author: Scikit-Plots Learn
description: A reusable decision log for selecting an estimator without hard-coded rankings.
empty_message: No one has applied Trace a model choice from requirements to evidence to this topic yet.
instruction:
1. Write the task, target, dataset shape, latency, memory, interpretability, and uncertainty requirements.
2. Map those requirements to a short candidate set.
3. Link each inclusion or exclusion to an explicit source or measured constraint.
4. Compare candidates under the same validation protocol.
5. Record the chosen trade-off and what evidence would cause the decision to change.
6. On re-run, rebuild the decision log from current requirements and evidence rather than appending a new verdict to the old one.
title: Trace a model choice from requirements to evidence
